150 dpi at final size (or 300 dpi at 1:2). Vector art scales without loss.
CMYK for accurate print colour (RGB is converted and can shift).

Keep text and logos ≥ 3–5 mm inside the trim so nothing is cut off.
Outline or embed all fonts before exporting.

artwork.title: Large-format setup
items: Design at final size, or a clean fraction (e.g. 1:10) — note the scale.
Keep key content inside the safe area, away from eyelets and pole pockets.
Convert hairlines to ≥ 1 pt so they hold at large size.

artwork.title: Before you send
items: Double-check spelling, contact details and the final size.
Flatten transparencies, or supply layered files if we've asked for them.
